stem:
Meera's grandmother in Jaipur explains how people long ago kept time by watching the sky. Meera lists three time units: a day, a lunar month, and a year.

Which row correctly matches each time unit to the sky cycle that defines it?

options.text: Day – Earth's revolution around the Sun; lunar month – Moon's phase cycle; year – Sun's apparent daily cycle
Day – Sun's apparent daily cycle across the sky; lunar month – Moon's complete phase cycle of about 29.5 days; year – Earth's revolution around the Sun of about 365.25 days
Day – Moon's phase cycle; lunar month – Sun's apparent daily cycle; year – Earth's revolution around the Sun
Day – Sun's apparent daily cycle; lunar month – Earth's revolution around the Sun; year – Moon's phase cycle

teacher.key_rationale: A day is defined by the Sun's apparent daily cycle (Earth's rotation), a lunar month by the Moon's full phase cycle of about 29.5 days, and a year by Earth's revolution around the Sun taking about 365.25 days. Only option B matches all three correctly; the other options swap the cycles among the units.
